preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As owner, call changeBurnFee() with parameters that set _burnFee > 2500 (25% limit). For example, set _burnFee = 5000 and _burnDivisor = 1000 to create a 50% burn fee. Then perform a token transfer to a non-excluded address - the recipient will receive tokens but immediately have 50% burned, effectively stealing value from users through excessive fees. Alternatively, use transferForeignToken() to drain any other tokens accidentally sent to the contract.
